_comment: Built-in layout of each LabVIEW MeasureData flavor, keyed by the exact MEASURE_DATA_FLAVOR name (the string pylabview writes to the extracted XML's <Flavor>); see src/lvkit/measure_data.py. 'layouts' name the user-extractable components of a flavor by the node's stored field index (a Bundle/Unbundle or Get Components node has nothing in the VI to resolve against); gaps (e.g. the analog waveform's error cluster at 3-6) are internal fields. 'value_layouts' give the flattened value of a flavor, named in 'flavors' under 'value': NI's 'Flattened Data' page says waveforms flatten like clusters (t0, dt, Y, error, attributes). A 'value' spec is a primitive TD_FULL_TYPE name, {"measure": flavor}, {"array": spec, "dimensions": n}, {"cluster": [[name, spec], ...]}, {"layout": name, "samples": spec} or {"samples": true} (the sample spec the referencing layout was given). A flavor without 'components' has no documented named components; one without 'value' has no known flattened layout (OldFloat64Waveform: no corpus VI holds one and the parser library marks its layout unfinished), so its values read as unreadable. Clean-room: the component names/order are the PUBLIC LabVIEW waveform/digital-data components (NI 'Get Waveform Components' docs), never licensed source.
